map.住院输液按医嘱设定每小时液体量（如 1000 ml / 8 小时），结合所用输液: For inpatient infusion, set the hourly fluid volume as ordered (for example 1000 ml over 8 hours) and combine it with the drop factor of the infusion set in use (commonly 15 or 20 drops/ml) to convert it into a drip rate per minute, so that nurses can adjust the Murphy drip chamber.
map.已知当前滴速（如 40 滴/分）与总量（如 500 ml），反推预计输注完成时间: From the current drip rate (for example 40 drops/min) and the total volume (for example 500 ml), work back to the estimated completion time, for shift planning and rounds.
map.按滴速分级（<20 慢速 / 20–60 常规 / 60–80 中速 / >80: Grade the drip rate (below 20 slow, 20-60 normal, 60-80 medium, above 80 fast) to assess infusion safety, and flag attention to circulatory load when the rate is too high.

map.总滴数 = 1000 × 15 = 15000 滴；总分钟 = 8 × 60 =: Total drops = 1000 × 15 = 15000 drops; total minutes = 8 × 60 = 480 minutes; recommended drip rate = 15000 ÷ 480 ≈ 31.3 drops/min (normal); hourly fluid volume = 1000 ÷ 8 = 125.0 ml/h. In reverse: 500 ml at 40 drops/min with drop factor 20 gives 10000 drops, taking about 250.0 minutes (4.17 hours) to finish, at 120.0 ml per hour.
map.滴系数（滴/ml）怎么选？: How should the drop factor (drops/ml) be chosen?
map.普通输液器多为 15 滴/ml，精密或微量输液器常为 20 滴/ml，具体以输液: Ordinary infusion sets are mostly 15 drops/ml, while precision or micro-infusion sets are often 20 drops/ml; follow the marking on the set packaging, because choosing wrongly biases the drip rate calculation directly.
map.滴速过快有什么风险？: What is the risk of too fast a drip rate?
map.滴速 >80 滴/分属快速，可能增加循环负荷，尤其对心功能不全者；工具会给出提示: Above 80 drops/min counts as fast and may increase circulatory load, especially for patients with impaired cardiac function; the tool issues a prompt, but the actual judgement rests with the medical staff.
